senses.gloss: m. (נסח) removal, only in ה׳ הדעת discarding from the mind, being given up, diverted attention.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:4:6">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵇ</cite> top <he>לא נפסלה בה׳ הד׳</he> it (the T’rumah) has not become degraded by your giving up the hope of using it.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ הד׳ דבר תורה</he> the law declaring T’rumah degraded by being given up is Biblical.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:4">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite> three things happen <he>בה׳ הד׳</he> when least thought of. V. <cite ref="E00707"><he>הֶסּיעַ</he></cite>.
